Can prices change after an item is added: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
Do items belong to categories?: Yes, every item has a category I choose, like Drinks, Toiletries or Foodstuff, and I want to see only one category at a time.
What if I add an item with a name that i: Refuse it. Milo and MILO are the same thing, so upper or lower case should not matter.
What currency and format are prices in?: Ghana cedis, sometimes with pesewas, like 12.50.
Can a price be zero or negative?: No, every price must be more than zero.
What happens when I take an item off the: It is gone: it does not show in the list and looking it up says it is not found.
